$comment: PRES-051 host lifecycle hook registrations for Skill 51 (signature-presentation). Supported plugin registrations only. Every handler is local, bounded, and read-only toward the engine: prerequisite, lease, persona, artifact/QC and completion enforcement stays in engine transactions (presentation_job Gates/close). Hooks delegate to the engine doctor/status validator and surface state; direct CLI or disabled hooks cannot waive gates. Async hook output never approves a transition. Timeouts: SessionStart 20s, PreToolUse 20s, PostToolUse 10s, Stop 15s.
